en.title: Rusted Signals and an Amber Farewell
en.premise: In an age where people live by offloading their "unpleasant memories" to the cloud, a Memory Tuner encounters an elderly man who chooses to retain his "worst memories," suffering from the resulting mental dissonance. The man seeks to protect nothing more than an abandoned lighthouse and a certain promise made there long ago. This is a story about reclaiming the "texture" of pain, lost in the pursuit of convenience.

zh.title: 生锈的信号与琥珀色的告别
zh.premise: 在一个人们将“不愉快的记忆”剥离并上传至云端生活的时代，身为记忆调律师的主角，遇见了一位执意保留“最糟糕记忆”并因此饱受精神不协和之苦的老人。老人想要守护的，是一座早已废弃的旧灯塔，以及在那里许下的某个约定。这是一个关于找回因追求便利而失去的、名为“痛苦”的触感的故事。
